conditions: Real x positive, real exponent r, real base b positive and not equal to one.
spoken_aliases: log base b of open parenthesis x raised to the power r close parenthesis equals r times log base b of x
the logarithm to base b of the quantity x raised to the power r equals r multiplied by the logarithm of x to base b

evidence: For positive x and b, write x=b^u where u=log_b x. The positive-real power law gives x^r=b^(ur) for real r; applying the inverse logarithm yields ru.

Reference cross-check of the standard identity: https://openstax.org/books/college-algebra-2e/pages/6-5-logarithmic-properties. Checked 2026-11-27. Approval is a maintainer review candidate, not independent human certification.
